page.layout: One page of text in a single column, centred block; page number top left, running head top right; closing word FINIS centred below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ptus piscium, vel avium, vel missilium emitur. L. nec emptio,8.D.eodem. D. An qui de piscatore bolum futurū emit,quamuis de piscibus uterque cogitabat,tamen quia nihil nominatim dictum est, de quovis bolo contra-xisse intelligatur.

page.notes: Running head at top right is in ornate decorative capitals and cannot be read reliably. The page number "200" is clear. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. Line-end hyphen in "contra-xisse" is printed. Text "emit,quamuis", "cogitabat,tamen" and "emptio,8.D.eodem" are copied with the printed spacing.
